def factor_intraday_pressure_simple(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"])
    pressure = intraday_ret - overnight_ret
    pressure_ewm = pressure.ewm(span=10, adjust=False).mean()
    factor = pressure_ewm
    factor.name = "factor_intraday_pressure_simple"
    return factor
